verdict.rationale: Veo's documentation index explicitly lists 'camera motion controls' and 'cinematic parameter notation' for configuring text-to-video generation (veo-docs-6). The Gemini API docs mention multi-turn editing that includes perspective changes (veo-docs-9). A community user names 'prompting motion' as a key differentiator of Google's tools (veo-comm-8-refresh-5d92e03d596840cb). However, this is a single thin index-level mention, with no documentation of the specific moves or of how reliably they are followed. missing for 10: detailed docs enumerating pan/zoom/orbit/static controls and how to specify them, evidence that requested camera moves are reliably honored, hands-on corroboration of camera direction.
